name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause Existence(door_open) is redundant. In the task, 'Open the door, then take the box' is captured by a hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up); the Precedence already forces door_open before the box is taken. The extra Existence(door_open) repeats this requirement and should be removed.

texts: The door must be opened before the target box is picked up.
The target box must be picked up at least once.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
